baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِ
baseline_models.mechanism: The causative أَضْلَلْنَ presents the feminine plural objects as agents of departure and loss, while رَبِّ invokes the counter-role of one who tends, repairs, and completes. كَثِيرًا scales the danger into population movement.

activation_trace.role: Repair, upbringing, and completion make the address a caretaker appeal over people made lost.
Departure from guidance and intended direction supplies the core routing failure.
Loss of a thing from its possessor sharpens straying into relational displacement.
Numerical growth makes the misdirection socially reproductive rather than isolated.

changed_reading.before: The idols caused many individuals to hold a false belief.
changed_reading.after: Ibrahim reports a large-scale loss of direction and asks the repairing caretaker to deal with a population displaced from its proper course.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَمَن تَبِعَنِي فَإِنَّهُ مِنِّي وَمَنْ عَصَانِي فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: Following is directional alignment behind Ibrahim, but مِنِّي converts alignment into belonging. The opposed clause names disobedience without supplying the expected inverse exclusion; it transfers that person to divine covering and mercy. The mercy root's kinship branch keeps familial belonging live beside allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Trailing and taking another's course supply the enacted alignment preceding مِنِّي.
Departure from obedience supplies the contrast without itself stating expulsion.
Covering the offense and protecting its bearer supplies the response to disobedience.
Kinship and relational bonds echo the belonging asserted by مِنِّي.

changed_reading.before: The obedient belong to Ibrahim, whereas the disobedient might be pardoned.
changed_reading.after: Following constitutes a person as 'of' Ibrahim, while disobedience is not answered with explicit severance but left inside God's covering mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah turns the focus causative into route architecture. A straight path is opposed by obstruction and crookedness; later blessing is exchanged, rivals are deliberately made, and misdirection is aimed away from a path. Idols work as installed rival waypoints, not unexplained autonomous objects.

activation_trace.role: A straight traversable path supplies the destination-relative geometry presupposed by straying.
Turning away and turning others aside supplies active blockage in the route.
Deviation of meaning from straightness makes distortion a means of rerouting.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the substitution preceding communal ruin.
A counterpart set in opposition supplies the rival waypoint competing for allegiance.
The causative purpose explicitly connects installed rivals with departure from direction.
An extended way to be traveled identifies what the rivals divert people away from.

structural_cues: 14:1 and 14:3 establish path, obstruction, and crookedness before 14:28-30 narrate substitution and made rivals.
The purpose construction in 14:30 directly joins rival-making to departure from the path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path geometry, substitution, made rivals, and misdirection; I infer the arrow from installing an alternative allegiance to rerouting people through it. A live alternative is that these are parallel descriptions rather than one routing mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Idols independently exert a mysterious misleading power.
changed_reading.after: They mislead as installed rival waypoints: substitution changes the route of allegiance and carries people away from the path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same movement is assigned at different levels to God, rival-makers, leaders, callers, and responders. Failed follower-leader dependency is followed by Satan denying coercive power and reducing his role to a call that people answered. Focus attribution can name effective social cause without granting idols independent coercion.

activation_trace.role: Divine causation of departure supplies a layer above the focus ayah's object-level attribution.
The weak trailing the arrogant supplies a concrete chain of misdirected followership.
Coercive force is explicitly denied, bounding how a misleading agent operates.
A verbal call that inclines another supplies the initiating social signal.
Answering speech supplies the followers' uptake that completes the causal circuit.
Blame redirected to respondents preserves their agency within the misleading relation.

structural_cues: 14:4 and 14:27 make God the subject of causative ض ل ل, while 14:30 gives rival-makers a misleading purpose.
14:21-22 moves from failed leader dependence to a caller who denies coercion and identifies follower response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies multiple agents, absent coercion, invitation, uptake, and blame; I infer nested causation in which made objects concentrate loyalties people ratify. A live alternative is direct rhetorical attribution without specified mediation.

changed_reading.before: The feminine plural subject is the sole efficient cause of straying.
changed_reading.after: Its causality is layered and participatory: installed rivals, leaders, invitation, uptake, answerability, and divine judgment converge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calling, answering, delay, and fixed term make followership temporal. The divine call opens forgiveness during a deferred term; later wrongdoers ask for delay so they can answer and follow. Focus following is a trajectory enacted while response remains possible, not a retrospective label.

activation_trace.role: The call that inclines hearers supplies the opening to guiding response.
Forgiveness tied to the call supplies repair within the response interval.
Postponement supplies a bounded interval rather than endless deferral.
A prescribed temporal limit closes the response interval.
Nearness in time makes the requested extension explicitly short.
Answering names the action omitted until warning arrived.
Following messengers is paired with answering, making it enacted response.

structural_cues: 14:10 orders call, forgiveness, postponement, and fixed term; 14:44 reverses this into a late request to answer and follow.
The focus assigns belonging after the act of following.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated call-response language and a closing window; I infer that 'follows me' is response embodied before the deadline. A live alternative is that 14:44 depicts repentance generally without defining 14:36.

changed_reading.before: Following Ibrahim is a static identity or profession.
changed_reading.after: Following is a time-sensitive trajectory: one becomes 'of me' by answering and taking the messenger's course while response can become lived practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The word-tree sequence supplies an organic account of becoming مِنِّي: a communicative word has rooted origin, stable branch, and recurring yield; its opposite is pulled out whole and lacks settlement. A follower can be read as propagated practice rather than merely a party member.

activation_trace.role: Meaningful speech connecting speakers supplies the transmissible source.
Rootedness and established origin supply continuity with the source.
Durability prevents propagated belonging from being momentary attachment.
A branch emerging from an origin supplies the material analogy for becoming 'from me.'
Recurring yield supplies an observable consequence of genuine propagation.
Extraction from the root supplies the contrary of source-continuity.
Denied stability and settlement expose what unrooted affiliation lacks.
Misdirection opposed to stabilization links the tree contrast to the focus danger.

structural_cues: 14:24-26 sustains word, root, branch, yield, uprooting, and lack of settlement.
14:27 restates the contrast as stabilization versus causative straying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a word propagated as a rooted tree; I map مِنِّي onto branch-from-source and following onto transmitted practice. A live alternative is that the tree concerns good speech generally without specifying Ibrahim's lineage.

changed_reading.after: To follow Ibrahim is to become stable, fruit-bearing propagation from his word and practice; 'of me' is enacted continuity, not genealogy alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence creates opposed fields of attraction. Ibrahim asks separation from worshipped bodies, reports their displacement of many people, then asks human hearts to incline toward his descendants at the protected House. Following becomes affective-spatial reorientation toward a prayer-bearing household.

activation_trace.role: Keeping apart supplies requested separation from idol worship.
A worshipped body identifies the immediate feminine plural danger.
Caused departure supplies the first attraction field's displacement.
A dwelling and shelter supplies the alternative spatial center.
The inwardly kindled heart makes the counter-movement affective.
The same human collective affected by idols supplies hearts for the counter-movement.
Inclination of the self supplies positive attraction toward the household.

structural_cues: 14:35-37 consecutively gives separation, mass misdirection, and requested inclination of people's hearts.
Both 14:36 and 14:37 use النَّاس for the human field under opposed pressures.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sequence, separation, displacement, a house, hearts, and inclination; I infer that the third petition establishes a counter-attractor. A live alternative is that the adjacent petitions are functionally independent.

changed_reading.before: A follower makes a primarily intellectual decision to obey.
changed_reading.after: Following is also affective-spatial reorientation: hearts incline toward Ibrahim's prayer-bearing household against idol displacement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prayer names descendants, gifted sons, parents, and believers, while the focus places a follower inside Ibrahim's مِنِّي and leaves a disobedient person to divine mercy. Biological lineage remains present, but allegiance admits people and prayer widens beyond descent.

activation_trace.role: Enacted adherence is the focus threshold for becoming مِنِّي.
Kinship bonds keep lineage semantics active in the appeal.
Smallness and dispersal supply an image for descendants propagated into a new place.
Children received as gift prevent descent from appearing self-produced.
The request to cover sins carries the focus ending into widened beneficiaries.
Parents defined through birth supply unmistakable genealogy.
Believers supply a non-genealogical community included beside self and parents.

structural_cues: 14:37-41 moves through descendants, gifted sons, descendants again, then self, parents, and believers.
14:36 formulates positive relation through following rather than birth and does not explicitly expel the disobedient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies genealogy, allegiance, and widening prayer objects; I infer an expandable lineage whose enacted criterion is following. A live alternative is that مِنِّي means party allegiance without genealogical coloring.

changed_reading.before: 'Of me' marks literal descent or a closed faction.
changed_reading.after: Ibrahim's 'me' is porous lineage: descent is named, but following admits people into enacted kinship and mercy reaches a wider relation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This transfers agricultural and womb images into a moral petition. It remains anchored because the focus begins with رَبِّ and ends with غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ, whose branches supply repair, covering, and life-bearing enclosure, while nearby context gives fruit in a barren setting. Render only as exploratory material analogy, not lexical replacement, and retain the uprooted-tree tension.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَبِّ ... وَمَنْ عَصَانِي فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

activation_trace.role: Repair and gradual completion supply the caretaker side of the analogy.
A protective cover supplies preservation rather than bare cancellation.
The womb as life-bearing enclosure supplies the bold restorative image.
Absence of cultivation supplies the difficult environment.
Requested ripe fruit supplies restoration across barrenness.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the disobedient is entrusted to a cultivator who can cover, shelter, and restore conditions for life and fruit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because the focus uses the ordinary verb 'follow,' while liability is another branch of the root. It remains live because مِنِّي accepts the follower into Ibrahim's relation and 14:21 stages followers asking leaders for relief. Render as ethical root resonance, never direct translation.

activation_trace.role: A consequence or claim adhering to a person supplies the responsibility resonance.
Followers attached to arrogant leaders supply the failed comparison.
The question whether leaders can avail them supplies an unmet protective expectation.

changed_reading.before: 'Of me' marks identity and affinity only.
changed_reading.after: As contained root resonance, Ibrahim may also accept answerability for followers unlike leaders unable to protect dependents.

strongest_changes: Idol causation became installed route architecture and distributed invitation-response rather than autonomous object agency.
مِنِّي became enacted, fruit-bearing, and porous lineage rather than blood descent or party identity alone.
Following became timely response, with late wished-for following distinguished from a lived prior course.
The 14:35-37 sequence set idol displacement against hearts inclining toward a prayer-bearing household.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrences unfolded route, agency, call-response, lineage, and cultivation mechanisms while preserving the focus asymmetry: following creates belonging, but disobedience is entrusted to God rather than explicitly answered with expulsion.
remaining_uncertainties: The relation between divine causation, human installation, invitation, and uptake remains unresolved.
The tree-to-lineage mapping is abductive and can concern belief or speech generally.
The counter-attraction reading depends on treating 14:35-37 as one functional sequence.
The cultivation and liability outliers are branch-distant and not direct lexical glosses.
